title: KREOLA
intro: Identity and packaging for a small luxury chocolatier making handmade truffles and bars from premium chocolate, sold through chain stores. Twenty-plus flavours, one tile pattern holding them all together.
brief: After a few years on plain kraft packaging with a logo sticker, KREOLA was moving into chain retail. It needed a full identity and production-ready packaging for several product lines: premium and handmade at once, and able to hold its own on a shelf of bigger brands.
did: The client chose a modern art deco direction, which we built into a modular tile pattern, each tile nodding to chocolate and its ingredients. Every flavour gets its own colour, so the pattern stays constant while the range stays easy to tell apart.

The real test was scale: several packaging types, each with a custom die-line, across more than twenty flavours. Every piece had to match the supplied copy exactly and meet retail labelling regulations, so ingredient panels, nutrition data, barcodes and certification marks were designed into the layout rather than squeezed in at the end.
